column1: Preheat the oven to 450°F (232°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Stir the flour, paprika, garlic powder, salt, pepper, and milk together in a large bowl until smooth.
Cut the cauliflower into florets about 1 1/2 inches wide and toss them in the batter until fully coated.
Spread the florets on the baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes, flipping halfway.
Mix the buffalo sauce, oil, and honey in a small bowl.
Brush the sauce over the cauliflower and bake another 20 minutes.
